Hunt: Showdown 1896 Blood Testament Event Survey
Introduction
Welcome to the latest Hunt: Showdown 1896 Event survey!
We are collecting feedback on the Event and the wider gameplay experience.
All your responses and feedback are anonymous. You can change the language by clicking on the menu in the top right corner.
This survey could take up to 15mins to complete it. Please read the questions and select answers carefully.
Thank you for your feedback.
